fusions.name: Edict Strike
fusions.desc: A thrown decree that deals 32 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Every ally gains 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Royal Advance
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and deal 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Standstill
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a bolt flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
